name: Deep Blue versus Garry Kasparov, 1997 rematch
summary: The six-game chess rematch in New York in May 1997 in which IBM's Deep Blue beat the reigning world champion Garry Kasparov 3.5 to 2.5.

ended.loc: P585 (point in time) of Game 6, revision 2568776621

result.v: Deep Blue won 3.5 to 2.5: Kasparov won game 1, Deep Blue won game 2, games 3 to 5 were drawn, and Deep Blue won game 6.

significance.v: IBM describes Deep Blue as the first computer system to defeat a reigning world chess champion in a match under standard tournament time controls.

preceded_by.v: The six-game match of February 1996 in Philadelphia, which Kasparov won 4 to 2.
